actual_scope: Prove that the published online magnitude bounds fit in the storage budget G with at least twelve spare bits.
scope_change_reason: The boundary band, q-factorization, Neumann tail, production domain, and error sum are different questions. This package checks the storage spare bits. It does not run the Gaussian core.
bottleneck_link: Every checked magnitude fits in G with at least 56 spare bits, and the selected kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Record this spare. Do not run the Gaussian core.
evidence: For every precision from 101 through 300, all 13 published magnitude bounds have bit length at most G-56. The prefix bound is the largest, and its spare is at least 56 for every precision at least 101.
